answer: Because the timing is recorded against the sonnet challenge, the beacon audit can replay the ridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 64 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3527 identities would post 4400 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
